summary: Improve Microsoft 365 records classification, retention and legal-hold workflows. Explore the five-day course and practical governance outputs.
lede: Digital records management training helps records managers, compliance officers and Microsoft 365 administrators govern cloud records. It covers building repository inventories, designing classification matrices, mapping retention schedules, documenting legal-hold workflows, and aligning privacy-aware access and disposition controls across SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 tools. Practical exercises produce governance artefacts and reporting templates; AI-assisted discovery and advanced Purview configuration are covered conceptually or as operational overviews, not production implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who control digital records, retention, privacy and discovery workflows across Microsoft 365 environments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools or records processes is helpful. No coding or programming is required. Microsoft Purview configuration is treated as an overview and workflow-design topic; access to a Microsoft 365 tenant is not required for the stated exercises.
